title: agoseris heterophylla
intro: Agoseris heterophylla, commonly known as mountain sneezeweed, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly by the indigenous peoples of North America, to treat various health conditions. The plant is said to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to combat infections. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of Agoseris heterophylla as containing sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other compounds, although further studies are needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds.
